title: Black Bean Burgers with Avocado Spread & Mixed Greens Salad

steps.text: Drain the beans (but don't rinse them) and transfer to a large bowl. Use a potato masher or fork to mash them until they are mostly broken up, but there are still some whole beans left.
Coarsely grate the onion and add to the bowl.
Add the bread crumbs, chili powder, salt, and pepper to the beans and onion; stir until the mixture is combined.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Form the bean mixture into four patties.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the patties in the skillet and cook until they are browned and heated through, 4 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the greens if they came pre-washed.)
Halve and pit the avocados; medium dice the flesh while it's still in the skin, then scoop out into a small bowl.
Add juice of 1 lime to the avocados and season with salt and pepper; mash with a fork until smooth.

Place the bun halves on four plates (or two plates and two lunch containers), top with the black bean patties, and add dollops of the avocado spread. Arrange the greens on the side, top with the grape tomatoes, and drizzle with olive oil and the remaining lime. Enjoy!
